notes.title: 𝕭𝖀𝕽𝕹 is out on Steam & Steam Deck 🔥
notes.content:
𝕭𝖀𝕽𝕹 is out on Steam and supporting Steam Deck 🔥

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1534660/BURN/

Thanks for playing and revewing BURN everyone.

We made 𝕭𝖀𝕽𝕹 to make an impact and we're so glad people are enjoying and finding it meaningful.

Here's a couple of our favourite reviews:

“A special ride and unquestionably a work of art” - madskdz

“BURN’s art and audio heighten the experience” - Press Jump to Start

Please help us share the news and leave a Steam review.

You can play 𝕭𝖀𝕽𝕹 in two different versions:

1. BURN - $5.99 USD (
2. BURN - Deluxe Edition ( BURN, Art Book and Screenplay ) - $9.99 USD

We also have a bundle with our debut, STONE ːsteamhappyː

You can get STONE - Bloody Legend ( STONE, Art Book and Screenplay ) and  and BURN - Deluxe Edition for $20 USD ( Save $5 USD ).

Please feel free to reach out for any issues on our Discussion board if you need anything and enjoy.

notes.title: 🔥 𝕭𝖀𝕽𝕹 Steam Deck Support Confirmed 🔥
notes.content:
We are proud to announce that we will be supporting Steam Deck at launch 🔥

We have have been testing with a small group and we can confirm that BURN does work on Steam Deck and fits the platform well. BURN is made for Windows PC first, but it does work on Steam Deck and has some keyboard shortcuts that can easily be configured to your preferred setup.

Please feel free to reach out for any issues on our Discussion board and Wishlist 𝕭𝖀𝕽𝕹!

Convict Games has been “breaking free since 2017” with its small but passionate remote team of highly-experienced developers willing to risk everything to create games like STONE and now 𝕭𝖀𝕽𝕹. With team members based everywhere from Australia to Finland, Convict Games boasts a global presence that it applies to its projects. Convict Games, BURN team has contributions to popular games such as Returnal, Cult of the Lamb, Noita, Carrion, Control, TormentorxPunisher, Quantum Break, Broforce, Nuclear Throne and films including Gravity, World War Z, Sucker Punch and Prometheus.
